explanation: Dimensions are \([\tau]=T\), \([\rho]=ML^{-3}\), \([\eta]=ML^{-1}T^{-1}\), and \([l]=L\). Therefore, \([\rho^a\eta^b l^c]=M^{a+b}L^{-3a-b+c}T^{-b}\). Equating with \(T\), we get \(a+b=0\), \(-3a-b+c=0\), and \(-b=1\). Hence \(b=-1\), \(a=1\), and \(c=2\).

Dimensions are \([p]=ML^{-1}T^{-2}\), \([V]=L^3\), \([J]=ML^2T^{-1}\), and \([u]=LT^{-1}\). For \(p^aV^bJ^cu^d\) to be dimensionless, the powers of \(M,L,T\) must vanish. Thus, \(a+c=0\), \(-a+3b+2c+d=0\), and \(-2a-c-d=0\). From \(a+c=0\), \(c=-a\). From the time equation, \(-2a+a-d=0\), so \(d=-a\). Substituting in the length equation gives \(-a+3b-2a-a=0\), hence \(3b=4a\). The smallest positive integer \(a\) giving integer \(b\) is \(a=3\), so \(b=4\), \(c=-3\), and \(d=-3\). Therefore, \(\Pi=\dfrac{p^3V^4}{J^3u^3}\).
